claim_text: China creating the new virus again in retaliation, with instruction to pray over the hospitals.
quote: I see China again creating that new virus
falsify_match: An engineered pathogen traced to China.
falsify_miss: None. The retaliation motive is what distinguishes this telling.

claim_text: Something hovering back and forth over Europe, and AI at the door bringing a time society has never seen, with the internet generation becoming a thing of the past like the dot com era.
quote: The internet generation will be a thing of the past
falsify_match: AI displacing the internet as the organising technology.
falsify_miss: The internet remains the substrate. The dot com comparison sets a recognisable scale of change.

claim_text: Pulled into the tribulation after the storm over Boston, with plagues, earthquakes and tsunamis, hospitals full of people and doctors behaving robotically as if they do not care, with AI behind it and China involved.
quote: the doctors act like they just don't care. It's robotic
falsify_match: AI-run triage in overwhelmed hospitals during an epidemic.
falsify_miss: No such scene. He places it in the tribulation, which removes any near-term bound.

claim_text: Numbers flashing in black and white with the 18th standing out, and the observation that the Boston Marathon and Coachella fall in the same week, with the Celtics playing the next day and uncertainty about whether Boston and New York are two different things.
quote: Boston Marathon, Coachella. They're all in the same week
falsify_match: An incident at one of the named events in that week.
falsify_miss: All passed without incident. He is working out which event the date attaches to rather than being told.

claim_text: The 18th insisted on regardless of which event falls when, with a viewer pointing out the NBA playoffs begin that day and him asking whether Boston and New York could meet in the playoffs.
quote: there's something about the 18th
falsify_match: A significant event on 18 April 2026.
falsify_miss: The day passed ordinarily. The content is being supplied by viewers in the chat, which he then adopts.

claim_text: He refuses to speculate further, saying you cannot add to it and that it is dangerous, and that the visions are clear and are to be prayed out rather than interpreted, with the two teams and the mass gatherings named.
quote: you cannot add to this. This is it's dangerous
falsify_match: Not applicable; a statement of method.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though refusing to speculate here sits oddly beside the speculation in the two passages before it.

claim_text: The spoils of Egypt promised again for the children, with fountains of wealth, great riches, deep hidden things and a greater manifestation of the presence so that they lack no good thing, conditional on listening.
quote: I will bring you fountains of wealth
falsify_match: Funds arriving at the scale described.
falsify_miss: None arrive, which under the listening condition is attributed to not having listened.

claim_text: He separates himself as just a man before giving what he says the Father told him about the economy and what he considers the president's next plan.
quote: I separate myself as I'm just a man
falsify_match: Not applicable; a framing.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: He gives the national debt as thirty two trillion and says the economy is in trouble with no stopping it, correcting himself from million to trillion mid-passage.
quote: 32 trillion in the hole
falsify_match: A debt crisis with no policy able to stop it.
falsify_miss: Debt service continues. The figure he uses is below the published level by 2026, which he elsewhere gives as forty trillion.

claim_text: Powell saying the American economy is in trouble, with the Lord anointing Trump to act, a three stranded cord seen, and things happening with Israel and with the American economy alongside the plans concerning Canada and Mexico.
quote: I saw a three-stranded cord
falsify_match: A three-way arrangement between America, Israel and one other.
falsify_miss: None forms. The three stranded cord recurs and is applied to different pairings across tellings.

claim_text: Iraq seen with military bases, oil ties and contracts attached to the American government from the invasion, alongside Iran being taken back to the stone age, with much of it turning on the tariffs.
quote: I saw Iran being taken back to the Stone Age
falsify_match: Iranian infrastructure destroyed to that degree.
falsify_miss: It recovers. Stone age is his standing phrase for the Iran outcome and is used without a threshold.

claim_text: The tariffs as plan A to keep the economy from going over the waterfall, and a scramble for plan B if the tariffs fall and trillions have to be paid back to other nations.
quote: Plan A is the tariffs. Plan B is I saw trying to scramble
falsify_match: Tariff revenue being ordered repaid and a policy scramble following.
falsify_miss: The tariffs stand. Repayment of collected tariffs following a court ruling is the specific scenario, which is checkable.

claim_text: Greenland, Venezuela and the uprising seen with minerals and oil as the plan, prayer over striking Iran's oil wells and the BRICS nations, and a statement that the civilian uprising was instigated by something much bigger than civilians which he cannot say online.
quote: Who instigated the civilians uprising?
falsify_match: An external hand shown behind the Iranian protests.
falsify_miss: None shown. He withholds the answer, which removes the checkable part.

claim_text: Plan B named as war: going after Iran's oil wells to back the dollar and bail the country out, with World War III, Venezuela and Cuba, an escalation to stimulate the economy, and the petrodollar rising as Iran's refineries are attacked.
quote: How do you back the dollar? How do you bail yourself out? War
falsify_match: An American war fought to support the currency, with the petrodollar strengthening.
falsify_miss: No such war. Naming the motive as monetary rather than security is the distinguishing claim.

claim_text: He says he warned repeatedly that the president would attack Venezuela first because of the black slick haired leader joining Russia, and that he was allowed into the meeting in the spirit where North Korea and Cuba were present with BRICS and Russia.
quote: President Trump would attack Venezuela first
falsify_match: Earlier recordings naming Venezuela as the first target before it happened.
falsify_miss: The earlier tellings name Venezuela repeatedly, which is on file; whether first is stated is the question.

claim_text: He describes being a fly on the wall in the BRICS meeting hearing things nobody knew he heard, with China and all the major nations there and Venezuela as the main target because they wanted its oil to back the arrangement, and says it is all on video that he called the attack.
quote: I was allowed to hear things that nobody else knew
falsify_match: The recordings containing the claim before the event.
falsify_miss: They do not. He appeals to his son and the audience to confirm the memory, which is the weaker check.

claim_text: The same passage repeated, with the point that the strike was done in the middle of the night without announcement, and the rhetorical question of when the president has ever announced a plan and then followed through with it.
quote: They did it in the middle of the night
falsify_match: As above.
falsify_miss: As above; repetition within the stream.

claim_text: He says he told viewers on New Year's Eve that within twenty four to forty eight hours a major event would take place and gave the date, and that the Venezuela attack came on the 3rd exactly in that window, which he says is on video.
quote: within the next 48 hours he's going to attack Venezuela
falsify_match: A New Year's Eve recording naming Venezuela and a window that contains the 3rd.
falsify_miss: The recording names a major event without the target, or the window does not contain it. He is unsure himself whether he said 24 or 48 hours, which matters for the window.

claim_text: The next phase given as eliminating Iran's ability for economic growth so that China has to buy its oil from someone else.
quote: The next phase is to eliminate Iran's ability for economic growth
falsify_match: Chinese purchases shifting away from Iranian crude.
falsify_miss: China continues buying. Chinese refiners take the large majority of Iranian exports, which is the flow that would have to move.

claim_text: Plan B restated as war on Iran's oil and infrastructure to set them back to the stone age under the umbrella of weapons of mass destruction, which he notes has been the argument for thirty years, and he recalls seeing a man with the King of England and Carney.
quote: we've been hearing that for 30 years plus
falsify_match: A stated weapons justification followed by infrastructure destruction.
falsify_miss: No such campaign. He identifies the justification as a pretext himself, which is unusual for him.

claim_text: A British figure calling Muslims the face of modern Britain, which he ties to the rising of the Mahdi and the antichrist spirit coming over Europe first.
quote: the rising up of the Mahdi and the Antichrist spirit coming over Europe
falsify_match: An Islamic political ascendancy in Britain of the kind he means.
falsify_miss: None. A politician's phrase about demographics is being read as the antichrist spirit arriving.

claim_text: The Olympics recalled, with the word that they will say the president has made his bed and must lie in it and that they want him to lose the midterms so the Democrats can impeach him, alongside twenty four billion dollars funnelled from the Biden administration to Ukraine into bank accounts.
quote: They want him to lose midterms to try to see
falsify_match: Democratic control of the House in 2026 followed by impeachment proceedings.
falsify_miss: Republicans hold, or no impeachment follows. The 2026 midterms make this dated and scoreable.

claim_text: European social credit scores coming with restrictions on what may be said, lawsuits against X, and great pressure put on Elon Musk, which he says he gave in advance.
quote: they'll sue X in the days ahead
falsify_match: European legal action against X and a social credit framework.
falsify_miss: EU proceedings against X under the Digital Services Act had been running publicly since 2023, which is the priority problem.

claim_text: Venezuelan oil taken to Houston and refined so that the war in Iran is already paid for, which he quotes the president as saying, and which he presents as what he saw.
quote: It's already paid for the war in Iran
falsify_match: Venezuelan crude refined in Houston covering the cost of the campaign.
falsify_miss: The accounting does not work. He is quoting a public statement rather than describing a vision here.

claim_text: America cornering the market in Venezuela, Mexico, Cuba and Colombia, striking cobalt and mineral deals with Greenland by threat rather than a shot fired, developing through Panama, and China taking Taiwan in retaliation for the chips while blackmailing with medicine.
quote: They'll corner the market in Mexico. They're going to corner it in Cuba
falsify_match: American control of Latin American oil supply and a Greenland minerals agreement.
falsify_miss: Neither. Cornering four national markets at once is the strong form of the claim.

claim_text: Lights coming out of Taiwan with China taking it and saying they are taking the chips, blackmailing with medicine including heart medicine unless demands are met, and a trade war over medicines coming.
quote: if you don't do it we're going to blackmail you with the medicine
falsify_match: China restricting pharmaceutical exports as leverage during a Taiwan crisis.
falsify_miss: No such restriction. China supplies a large share of the world's active pharmaceutical ingredients, which is the dependency he is pointing at.

claim_text: Taiwan falling to China within a couple of days of the first strike and being taken over, alongside the stone age for Iran and Iraq becoming like Saudi Arabia with America holding great stakes in its oil.
quote: I saw Taiwan falls to China within a couple of days
falsify_match: Taiwan falling within days of an invasion beginning.
falsify_miss: No invasion, or a long campaign. A couple of days is a hard bound and matches his earlier two-day telling.

claim_text: The Turkish leader seen putting on a cloak with a brooch at the neck, becoming a tyrant with war over the Black Sea and what comes in and out of it, controlling Europe, with him and Russia friends.
quote: the guy that's over Turkey, put on a cloak
falsify_match: Turkey closing the straits and aligning with Russia against Europe.
falsify_miss: Turkey stays in NATO. The Montreux Convention already gives it authority over the straits in wartime.

claim_text: Turkey rising with massive war drums beating in the Black Sea, and the president of Turkey putting on a Count Dracula cape with a high collar and a brooch over a white shirt, hair slicked back like the old films.
quote: he put on a Count Dracula cape
falsify_match: Turkish naval action in the Black Sea.
falsify_miss: None. The Dracula image is Romanian rather than Turkish, which is worth noting since he treats it as identifying.

claim_text: Weapons of war never seen before used by Putin, Turkey blocking the waterway into the Black Sea, Russia annihilating Zelensky, and World War III written large across Ukraine and spreading over all Europe.
quote: making it where it was impossible to go into the Black Sea
falsify_match: The Bosphorus closed to shipping during a general European war.
falsify_miss: It stays open. Turkey has already restricted warship transits under Montreux, which is the partial version of this.

claim_text: He works out the map with his son and repeats that Turkey will control that passage to help Russia and that this is where they will control Europe, with an escalation coming.
quote: that's where they're going to control Europe
falsify_match: Turkey exercising decisive leverage over Europe.
falsify_miss: It does not. He locates Ukraine on the map on air, which shows the geography being worked out rather than seen.

claim_text: Everyone having to come to America and its allies, with instruction to pray over Houston, Tuttle, Louisiana, the main manufacturing plants, the grid, electricity, water and infrastructure, and cities without power for three to four weeks or longer in retaliation.
quote: I saw cities without power for up to three to four weeks
falsify_match: An American city without power for three weeks or more after an attack.
falsify_miss: No such outage. The duration has now been given twice, at three weeks and three to four weeks.

claim_text: Sleeper cells named as the reason for the retaliation, with the tariffs having failed leading to the valley of decision and now war and oil to keep America top dog, and prayer for the president's mind against counsel from outside his circle.
quote: It was the Valley of Decision
falsify_match: Domestic attacks following the Iran campaign.
falsify_miss: None occur. The causal chain he sets out, tariffs failing so war follows, is the substantive claim.

claim_text: An account of being taught by the Lord about crypto and about cars, including being told a man in a white shirt would knock and buy a car, which he says happened, turning eight hundred dollars into three thousand five hundred.
quote: The man with the white shirt is going to knock on the door
falsify_match: Not checkable; a personal anecdote from years earlier.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. It is offered as the pattern for how he expects financial instruction to work.

claim_text: People leaving Boston because of an attack about to take place and moving to Texas and Oklahoma, with prayer that they do not vote blue when they arrive and change the Bible Belt.
quote: Pray they don't change things blue
falsify_match: An attack in Boston followed by measurable out-migration to Texas and Oklahoma.
falsify_miss: Neither. The political consequence he fears is the specific part, and it is the opposite of what he says happens.

claim_text: Revival called over Oklahoma, Texas, Kansas, Arkansas and Missouri spreading east, west, into Canada, Mexico and South America, with the live viewer count read out as four million one hundred and twenty thousand.
quote: Kansas will turn around and start having a revival
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition, though the audience figure is checkable.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. He reads the number as four million and then corrects the arithmetic on air.

claim_text: Minnesota called saved and born again with Holy Ghost fire, and the red wave coming from Michigan and Minnesota.
quote: I'm calling Minnesota saved
falsify_match: Republican gains and religious growth in Minnesota and Michigan.
falsify_miss: Neither. Both states are named repeatedly across the corpus for both outcomes at once.

claim_text: Fountains springing forth in Tennessee and Alabama, uncapped at a greater and greater level, with instruction to declare that the well of revival is uncapped in your own neighbourhood and that it starts with you.
quote: THE WELL of revival is uncapped
falsify_match: Revival at the named states.
falsify_miss: None. It starts with me places the outcome on the listener, which makes absence explicable.

claim_text: The sequence traced again from Minnesota to Tennessee to Mobile to Fort Worth to Oklahoma, with marks appearing on the map like the travel sequence in Indiana Jones and wells springing forth at each.
quote: there's marks on the map
falsify_match: Revival appearing in that order at those places.
falsify_miss: It does not. The Indiana Jones map image recurs from the golden goose telling.

claim_text: A brand new Trump Tower built over New York, glass fronted with Trump at the top rather than above the doors, tapering to a V or triangular base like the Oklahoma City building.
quote: I saw a brand new Trump Tower being built
falsify_match: A new Trump tower announced in New York with that profile.
falsify_miss: None announced. The triangular base and the name at the top are the identifying details.

claim_text: Barron seen in formal dress marching toward and going up the stairs of a skyscraper twice the size of the New York Trump Tower.
quote: I saw Barron going up the stairs
falsify_match: The president's youngest son taking a public role in a major development.
falsify_miss: He does not. Doubling the height of Trump Tower would make it among the tallest buildings in the city, which is checkable.

claim_text: Prayer asked for Don Jr and the family over their real estate, with coins seen waddling in a parade like the seven dwarfs going into the building.
quote: I could see the coins, and they were waddling
falsify_match: A Trump family crypto or real estate venture at that scale.
falsify_miss: None. The coins going into the building is the detail that ties the family to the digital money material.

claim_text: Iran seen completely decimated with all the buildings on fire and oil burning everywhere, like Mad Max or Waterworld, set back to the stone ages.
quote: Oil was burning all over the place
falsify_match: Widespread destruction of Iranian cities and oil infrastructure.
falsify_miss: Damage stays confined to military and nuclear sites, which is what the June 2025 campaign did.

claim_text: Old Babylon rising with faces in Iraq that had been held back, and the prince of Persia losing his grip on the Iraqi financial system as his fingers were broken off.
quote: His fingers were no longer able to grip it
falsify_match: Iranian influence over Iraqi finance visibly broken.
falsify_miss: It holds. Iranian-aligned parties control substantial parts of the Iraqi state, which is what would have to change.

claim_text: Money moving around Iraq once Iran's grip is broken, with corruption remaining but no longer enough to hold it back, Maliki's face seen and puppets of Iran fading away as new leadership comes in, with industrial blessing like Saudi Arabia's.
quote: I saw Maliki's face
falsify_match: Maliki and other Iranian-aligned figures losing position in Iraq.
falsify_miss: They retain influence. Naming Maliki specifically is the checkable part of the Iraq material.
